summary: Independent review of all 237 Chinese units in Song History juan 76 (Huangyou armillary, clepsydra, and gnomon table treatise). Han and Song project datings anchored on 永元十五年, 延熹七年, 祥符初, and 皇祐初/元年/四年 are source-supported with orthodox Western conversion. The undated 其後 maker catalogue at s0008 must not carry person-specific Western intervals or matching hints. Luoxia Hong Taichu attestation and Yao Chong AD 103 pairing over-read calendrical witness. He Chengtian hint imports biography beyond the Liu-Song mention.
